WITH date_slice AS (
    SELECT d_year,
           MIN(d_date_sk) AS min_d_date_sk,
           MAX(d_date_sk) AS max_d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY d_year
),
web_summary AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           'w' AS sale_type,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 THEN ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS w_1998,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS w_1999,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 THEN 1 END) AS w_1998_cnt,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN 1 END) AS w_1999_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_slice ds ON ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN ds.min_d_date_sk AND ds.max_d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
web_pruned AS (
    SELECT customer_sk,
           sale_type,
           w_1998,
           w_1999,
           w_1998_cnt,
           w_1999_cnt
    FROM web_summary
    WHERE w_1998_cnt > 0
      AND w_1998 > 0
      AND w_1999_cnt > 0
),
store_summary AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           's' AS sale_type,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS s_1998,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS s_1999,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 THEN 1 END) AS s_1998_cnt,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN 1 END) AS s_1999_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_slice ds ON ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN ds.min_d_date_sk AND ds.max_d_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_pruned wp WHERE wp.customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk)
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
       c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
       c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM store_summary st
JOIN web_pruned wt ON wt.customer_sk = st.customer_sk
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = st.customer_sk
WHERE st.sale_type = 's'
  AND wt.sale_type = 'w'
  AND st.s_1998_cnt > 0
  AND st.s_1998 > 0
  AND st.s_1999_cnt > 0
  AND wt.w_1998_cnt > 0
  AND wt.w_1998 > 0
  AND wt.w_1999_cnt > 0
  AND CASE WHEN wt.w_1998 > 0 THEN wt.w_1999 / wt.w_1998 ELSE 0.0 END
    > CASE WHEN st.s_1998 > 0 THEN st.s_1999 / st.s_1998 ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id,
         c.c_first_name,
         c.c_last_name,
         c.c_email_address
LIMIT 100

1. DATE-SLICE PUSHDOWN — TARGET: the `store_sales`/`web_sales` × `date_dim` joins in both `year_total` branches — TRANSFORMATION: precompute the `d_date_sk` ranges for `d_year = 1998` and `d_year = 1999` and scan only those date slices of `store_sales` and `web_sales`, removing the all-years aggregation and the per-row `date_dim` join.

2. CROSS-CHANNEL SEMI-JOIN PRUNING — TARGET: the 57M-row `store_sales` aggregation branch — TRANSFORMATION: first compute the set of `c_customer_sk` values that satisfy the web-side requirements (positive 1998 web total and an existing 1999 web total), then restrict the `store_sales` aggregation to only those customers, discarding store customers that cannot appear in the final result before the large aggregation.

3. CONDITIONAL PIVOT AGGREGATION — TARGET: the four `year_total` references (`t_s_firstyear`, `t_s_secyear`, `t_w_firstyear`, `t_w_secyear`) and the final four-way self-join on `customer_id` — TRANSFORMATION: aggregate each channel once per `c_customer_sk` with separate conditional sums for 1998 and 1999, then join the resulting one-row-per-customer store and web summaries on `c_customer_sk`, eliminating the four-way CTE self-join and the separate 1998/1999 rows.

4. DEFERRED CUSTOMER ENRICHMENT — TARGET: the early `customer` joins and the seven-column aggregation in each branch — TRANSFORMATION: aggregate fact rows first using only `ss_customer_sk`/`ws_bill_customer_sk`, then join `customer` after aggregation to fetch `customer_id`, `customer_first_name`, `customer_last_name`, and `customer_email_address`, so the large hash aggregation does not group by customer text columns.
